title: Best Home Insurance 2026
description: Lemonade, Amica Mutual, State Farm, USAA, Allstate compared.
lede: Five home insurers compared by digital experience, customer service, and bundling.
methodology: Requested quotes for same $400K home. Compared coverage, claims, bundling.

sections.heading: Digital vs. traditional
paragraphs: Digital (Lemonade): online signup, AI claims. Mutuals (Amica, USAA): top service. Majors (State Farm, Allstate): broad availability.

faqs.a: Coverage A = rebuild cost. B = 10% of A. C = 50% of A. D = 20% of A.

amica-mutual-homeowners.review: JD Power #1, mutual company, no agents.

allstate-homeowners.review: All 50 states, mobile app for claims.
